sections.Before taking sonidegib,: tell your doctor and pharmacist if you are allergic to sonidegib, any other medications, or any of the ingredients in sonidegib capsules. Ask your pharmacist or check the Medication Guide for a list of the ingredients.tell your doctor and pharmacist what prescription and nonprescription medications, vitamins and nutritional supplements you are taking or plan to take while taking sonidegib. Your doctor may need to change the doses of your medications or monitor you carefully for side effects. the following herbal product may interact with sonidegib: St. John's wort. Be sure to let your doctor and pharmacist know that you are taking this medication before you start taking sonidegib. Do not start this medication while taking sonidegib without discussing with your healthcare provider.tell your doctor if you have or have ever had muscle disease.tell your doctor if you are breastfeeding. Your doctor may tell you not to breastfeed while you are taking sonidegib and for 20 months after your treatment.

Talk to your doctor about the risks of taking sonidegib if you have concerns about fertility.Sonidegib may cause growth to stop early in children. This medication is not recommended for use in children.Sonidegib may cause other side effects. Call your doctor if you have any unusual problems while taking this medication.If you experience a serious side effect, you or your doctor may send a report to the Food and Drug Administration's (FDA) MedWatch Adverse Event Reporting program online (https://www.fda.gov/Safety/MedWatch) or by phone (1-800-332-1088).
